cases.description: new_intent/no_match -> classified via the shared Error Parser with the agent's own composed message, route_key cleared so the Router's fallback safely absorbs it instead of dispatching a second time

new_intent/no_match -> actually reaches and calls Response for delivery (this was the bug: this branch used to skip straight to Return Intent Finder Result without ever calling Response) -- proven by the pinned Response's own output surviving to the final node, since Execute Workflow replaces the item wholesale
new_intent/error -> classified via the shared Error Parser as AGENT_ERROR, same self-contained deliver+clear pattern as no_match

a genuine agent/tool failure is handled entirely within this sub-workflow (classify + deliver), bypassing the Router -- Response is pinned here only to avoid a live Django HTTP call in this test, not because that's how it behaves for real
